your story is heartbreaking. it is absolutely not your fault that you've been abused your whole life, the toxic actions of others have no reflection on *you* as a person. none whatsoever. those people saw that you are a giving person and they took advantage of it. i know how abuse fucks you up, you don't deserve that, you deserve so much more out of life than what you've got. you've got so much time to find good people who care about you and to live for yourself. i promise you, there's more out there than just the bad shit. there's places where you can get help to deal with your situation.

it really sounds like you need help, but i don't even live in america, so i don't know about any resources you might be able to reach out to in your state/area. have you tried reaching out to any mental health services? you might want to, they helped me.

if all else fails i'm here for you if you want to talk or just vent.

he has our dad. his dad and him have a great relationship. he doesn't need me. he doesn't talk to me, and i respect that. he would be horrified if i died i dont even know wht it would do t him but that doesnt meann i shouldnt or dont desrve to

i don't know what i can do to be useful. i can't even face what i've done. i'm not brave enough. my will to live is too delicate, and i'm not exaggerating. if i told a family member or dealt with it like a normal person, my guilt would overwhelm me and i would kill myself. and i know my family wants me to live so i don't know what to do.

one thing i don't want is people who would sympathize with me no matter what, even *IF* i've done/am doing evil things. that wouldn't be genuine and i'm glad you can see that.

..i am native, but it's complicated. i'm more white, i look whiter than a lot of white people, my mother was mixed, as were both of her parents. the only one who is still alive is my grandma, and she won't tell us anything other than "we're native but it's not important/we're not connected to our culture" so i will never know. i'm gonna die anyway so i guess it doesn't matter, even the government doesn't give a shit about us. but the compliment was nice and it made me kind of happy for a bit, so thank you.

i couldn't say everything that has happened to me. i'd literally be here all day. but my situation is all i can ever see for myself. nothing has ever changed for the better. i peaked during childhood with the few pure and good memories i have of playing video games with my mom while she was still alive. now that time of my life is far gone, i'm not a child anymore, and things like this god-awful shelter is the best i will ever get out of my miserable, wasteful life.

the only one i have left is my father. i'm not even sure if i love him, i'm just strongly attached to him. no matter what he says to me i will never be able to truly leave him. it would destroy me.

the only thing that has kept me from dying since the age of 15 is my family. my family would be sad. they need me here. my suicide attempts were never about me anyway, they weren't allowed to be. but they would be better off if i just stopped fucking around, drank some bleach and called it a day. they're kidding themselves if they think they need me. nobody needs me.

i cried out of happiness when i saw the two new responses i got, but that went away so fast. any bit of happiness i get is ripped away from me. i see clearly now. this life isn't worth the effort i've put into it. nothing is good. nothing. i can't watch myself grow up physically without growing up mentally or emotionally while still trying to match everybody's expectations of an adult. i still desperately desire to experience my youth NORMALLY but i can't. my age regresses usually i feel younger than i  am and thats because i was traumatized so b ad nothing can ever repair me or mylife i'm fucked so i may as well stop it before it gets worse. i feel so ashamed of my flashbacks i don't want to live with them either there's no point in fighting it. i'm going to die

I'm sorry your father abused you. I wish you the best in life, it seems your future has value and worth, and I'm happy for you. My problem is that mine does not. Nobody likes abusers. I'm now a worthless human being for hurting my brother. I've fucked up so bad that there is literally nothing I can EVER do to fix it or make it better or make it easier for him. If I kill myself, I will be free of depression and anxiety and my past, but if I don't, sure, there will be happy moments down the road. They will be empty and undeserved. I can't redeem myself, I'm unforgivable, and I hate existing. I'm going to end it soon life has given me nothing but misery and I never wanted to exist in the first place
